title: End-to-End Transfer Learning on Custom Data 🌼
description: Apply transfer learning to a new image dataset with training and evaluation.

slides.title: Putting It All Together 🧩
slides.content:
# Full Pipeline

We'll use a small flower dataset (like Oxford 102 Flowers, but we'll simulate with torchvision's Flowers or use a tiny subset).

Steps:
1. Load pretrained model, replace head.
2. Freeze backbone, train only head for a few epochs.
3. (Optional) Unfreeze some layers, fine‑tune with low LR.
4. Evaluate.

slides.title: Dataset & Transforms
slides.content: Using torchvision.datasets.Flowers102 or a generic ImageFolder. We'll use ImageFolder for custom data.
slides.codeSnippet:
from torchvision import transforms, datasets

# Transforms as recommended by pretrained weights
weights = models.ResNet18_Weights.DEFAULT
transform = weights.transforms()

# If you have your own data:
train_ds = datasets.ImageFolder('path/to/train', transform=transform)
val_ds = datasets.ImageFolder('path/to/val', transform=transform)

train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=32, shuffle=True)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=32)

slides.title: Model & Optimizer Setup
slides.content: Prepare the model with feature extraction first.
slides.codeSnippet:
model = models.resnet18(weights=weights)
for param in model.parameters():
    param.requires_grad = False
model.fc = nn.Linear(model.fc.in_features, len(train_ds.classes))

# Only fc parameters will update
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.fc.parameters(), lr=0.001)
criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()

slides.title: Training Loop (Feature Extraction)
slides.content: Train only the head for 10 epochs.
slides.codeSnippet:
for epoch in range(10):
    model.train()
    for imgs, lbls in train_loader:
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        out = model(imgs)
        loss = criterion(out, lbls)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
    # validation...

quizData.question: During feature extraction, which parameters get updated?

options.text: Only the parameters of the new fc layer

quizData.explanation: We froze all layers except the new classifier head.

slides.title: Fine‑Tuning Phase (Optional) ⚙️
slides.content:
## After Head Training

Once the new head converges, we can unfreeze the backbone (or part of it) and train the entire network with a much lower learning rate (e.g., 1e-5).

```python
for param in model.parameters():
    param.requires_grad = True
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=1e-5)
# Continue training for a few more epochs
```

slides.title: Fine‑Tuning Entire Network
slides.content: Unfreeze all and lower learning rate.
slides.codeSnippet:
for param in model.parameters():
    param.requires_grad = True

optimizer_ft = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=1e-5)
# Train for another 5 epochs...

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Learning Rate Schedulers for Fine‑Tuning

Use `ReduceLROnPlateau` or cosine annealing to slowly reduce learning rate during fine‑tuning, helping convergence.
